rules: Walks: shortest path by length over net (edge length in decimetres) from the start place's node to the end place's node, fee ways only when the start or end place has ticket, a walled palace ends at its door; walkM = path/10 + start snapM + end snapM, rounded. Lists: food = kind restaurant/cafe, sights = kind sight, matched by serves/kind/type, reference place itself left out, nearest walk first; 'open now' lists use the trip-pack.md order (open/outdoor/visit-allowed, then days-not-stated, then unknown; closed left out) with hours evaluated at 'at'.
